description: Defines data classes for app metadata and localization, including AppV1 and Localized, with methods to convert to MetadataV2 and handle localized resources.

classes.name: AppV1
classes.description: Data class representing application metadata with localization support and conversion to MetadataV2.

classes.name: Localized
classes.description: Data class for localized resources such as images, text, and screenshots.

methods.name: toMetadataV2
methods.description: Converts AppV1 instance to MetadataV2, handling localization and resource mapping.

methods.name: getLocalizedTextV2
methods.description: Retrieves localized text based on locale, falling back to default localization.

methods.name: Map<String, Localized>.toLocalizedTextV2
methods.description: Converts a map of localized resources to LocalizedTextV2.

methods.name: Map<String, Localized>.toLocalizedFileV2
methods.description: Converts a map of localized resources to LocalizedFileV2.

methods.name: Map<String, Localized>.toLocalizedFileListV2
methods.description: Converts a map of localized resources to LocalizedFileListV2.
